title: SvgAnimateMotion
responsibility: Renders the native animateMotion element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgAnimateMotion.children
inputs.description: Optional Snippet that the component renders as the content of the animateMotion element through {@render children()} only when the value is truthy; when it is omitted the element has no content. The component calls it with no arguments, so the value must be a Snippet.

outputs.name: SvgAnimateMotion
outputs.description: The native animateMotion SVG element, rendered through svelte:element with every prop except children spread onto it as an attribute and the children snippet, when provided, as its content. The component adds no wrapper element around it.
